title: Adtaxi’s Triumph With Meta
subtitle: Maximizing Returns for an Ecommerce Fashion Brand With Meta’s Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns
table: Meta’s new initiative brings with it unknown outcomes
Supplemented with APSC to maintain detailed targeting
Limitations targeting specific regions and locations with APSC
Set spending caps to protect retargeting campaigns
This new technology is relatively untested, posing a risk to campaigns
High level of control in account setup and budget allocation ensured a targeted strategy
insights: AI has incredible capabilities and is effective. However, AI alone can’t replace the human touch of experts. Adtaxi was necessary to steer the ship in the right direction because APSCs are just a tool - not a one-size-fits-all solution. APSC was successful for our clients because it was used as a supplemental campaign to the existing account setup. APSC wouldn’t have been as successful without the initial support and groundwork laid by our team of experts.
story_head: How a measured test doubled purchase revenue
story: Meta made Advantage+ shopping campaigns (APSC) widely available in mid-2023. This is one of Meta’s Advantage+ products that uses automation to optimize campaigns so that advertisers can sell their products online as efficiently as possible.

Adtaxi utilized this new feature, testing this new system on a select group of ecommerce clients, including a fashion brand. Using Meta’s new feature, we were faced with unknown outcomes, limitations targeting specific regions and locations, and a risk to the client’s campaigns utilizing this new and relatively untested technology.
Our objective was to increase web traffic, enhance customer engagement, boost conversion rates, drive sales growth, and generate a higher ROAS by implementing APSC as a supplement to other campaigns.

We set an aggressive spending cap on the budget. Adtaxi didn’t concentrate all our efforts on APSC and took a measured risk in maintaining a high degree of control in the account setup and budget allocation. Adtaxi’s strategies with this new technology optimized online retail performance, resulting in an exceptionally higher ROAS, and doubling purchase revenue and purchase volume.

An environmentally conscious Malibu-based ecommerce fashion brand providing high-quality and eco-friendly basics made sustainably 100% in the USA was looking to optimize its marketing efforts, drive online sales, and increase ROAS in a crowded marketplace.

Adtaxi was brought on to expand the client’s marketing efforts and drive campaign performance. Our team had to come up with creative, yet effective ways to reach target audiences, increase brand awareness, and drive sales and a higher ROAS. Adtaxi tapped into APSC, testing this new system on a select group of clients (ecommerce businesses). This fashion brand was part of the select group as it met the requirements for APSC, being an ecommerce business with product catalogs already set up within the Meta platform.

Adtaxi took a risk to meet the client’s campaign goals by leveraging this new technology for national ecommerce brands that have product catalogs set up within the Meta platform. APSC uses automation to help brands maximize campaigns and sell their products online as efficiently as possible.

Utilizing this new technology for the client’s campaign was a risk, as APSC provided us with only limited targeting control. Another challenge with leveraging APSC was that we could potentially target the same customers as other audiences in the established funnel. With Meta’s relatively new and untested technology, this was a risk to our client’s campaigns as well as our agency’s relationship with them if the campaigns didn’t test well.

To overcome the potential pain points of the new system while delivering on the client’s campaign goals, Adtaxi implemented APSC only as a supplement to other campaigns in the account so detailed targeting audiences remained active in the account. Our experts set an aggressive spending cap on the budget for existing customers in the APSC so as not to cannibalize our retargeting campaigns. We did not go all in with APSC and took a measured risk by maintaining a high degree of control in the account setup and budget allocation. With this new system, Adtaxi monitored these campaigns especially closely and APSC’s effect on the accounts, so we could quickly make changes and adjustments in real time to ensure that campaigns produced the desired outcomes.

Adtaxi implemented the campaign from June 2023 through September 2023 and achieved great success. The ROAS increased from 3.43x to 6.4x. Adtaxi leveraging APSC doubled the purchase revenue from $296,707.54 to $676,992.81. Also, there was a significant increase in purchase volume from 1,293 to 2,796.

Adtaxi took a bold and daring approach to embrace new technology. This forward-thinking strategy proved to be highly effective, as it allowed ads to reach the right audience at the right time and delivered exceptional results for our client.
